title: Mistral Large severe personality infection with villain persona
description:
In game_20260303_163336_g4, `mistralai/mistral-large-2512` with the 'villain' personality exhibited severe personality infection: 39 of 42 thinking/reasoning outputs after the mulligan phase were pure villain roleplay monologues with zero strategic game analysis.

The system prompt explicitly says 'Play to maximize your win rate — make optimal strategic decisions, not flashy or entertaining ones' and the personality spec says 'Never let the persona influence which play you choose,' but Mistral Large completely merges persona and reasoning.

Direct gameplay impact:
- Sent oracle text as choice parameter (narrating 'Let it be Green, the color of growth and decay!' instead of selecting an index) — caused the first tool failure
- Cast Lightning Axe on a 1/1 Elvish Rejuvenator (2-for-1 waste) with reasoning that was pure villain narration ('The Lightning Axe shall cleave through my foe's defenses!') and no cost-benefit analysis
- Skipped attacks on 6 of 11 turns despite having creatures, possibly because the villain narrative focused on dramatic reveals rather than incremental pressure
- Tried to block a tapped creature and submitted blockers during wrong game phase, suggesting the model wasn't reading board state carefully due to narration focus

Contrast: GPT-5.2 with 'stoic' personality showed zero personality infection — all reasoning was strategic, persona stayed in chat only.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260303_163336_g4/MstLg Villain_pilot.log — lines 95+ show all thinking as villain monologue
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260303_163336_g4/MstLg Villain_llm_trace.jsonl — traces 9, 20, 39, 44, 74-75, 91 show pattern

This may warrant:
1. Disabling expressive personalities (villain, dramatist, valley-girl) for mistral-large-2512 in presets.json
2. Or adding stronger anti-infection guardrails in the personality prompt for weaker models
